capabilities: Chat with notes and cite sources used
Organize sources into a knowledge base with checkups
Browse, correct, pin, or forget long-term memory
Generate notes, Canvas layouts, and drawings from sources
Run a local MCP server exposing authorized knowledge and memory
disambiguation: Not only a chat assistant; it also maintains a knowledge base, editable memory, journal, to-dos, and a local MCP server for other agents.
extras: Freemium: Free, PRO, and Max tiers gate @Agent in notes, PDF reading, finance, MCP server, and cloud sync. Mobile is Beta and unverified on physical devices; native Windows, Linux, and Android validation incomplete. Plugin file exceeds Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB per-file limit, so install per device. Desktop can access files outside the vault by permission mode and run configured local MCP commands. Web search and MinerU each need their own account and billing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions across the whole vault with source citations or to maintain editable long-term memory about the user.

relations.evidence: drawings require Excalidraw 2.29 or later enabled and a model supporting tool calls

summary: AI agent plugin that chats with vault notes using cited sources, organizes material into a knowledge base, and keeps editable long-term memory.
